run_experiment_test: run the experiment test script to verify the adversarial robustness experiment imports and executes a single step
test_experiment_function: test the experiment by creating an Experiment instance with dry run config and taking a single step
run_experiment_step: run a single experiment step using jax pmap broadcast with a PRNG key and global step
test_experiment_config: test the experiment configuration by setting dry run mode, batch size, and model depth and width
run_experiment_main: run the main entry point that executes the experiment test via absl app
